name: karim-workflow
description: Delivery discipline for agent-assisted builds. A gate that runs before any non-trivial code so assumptions are stated first; a nine-file project context scaffold so an agent starts a session already knowing the codebase; a Figma-first contract that refuses to write screen code without a frame and a motion spec; a licence-tracked asset pipeline so nothing ships on an unclear licence; and a delivery factory that turns an idea into shipped assets.
